title: Standard Paginated List Response
description: Canonical shape for the JSON body of paginated list endpoints across platform microservices. See openspec/specs/api-pagination/spec.md for the normative requirements. Services should compose this with their own `data` item schema via $ref/allOf.

data.description: The page of items. Item shape is defined per-endpoint.

pageSize.description: Number of items requested per page.

totalItems.description: Optional. Total number of items across all pages.

totalPages.description: Optional. Must equal ceil(totalItems / pageSize) when both are present.
